findings.description: The prompt text is now `.strip()`ped whenever ANSI stripping applies, which also removes the trailing space that separates the prompt from user input (e.g. "Name: " becomes "Name:").
findings.rationale: Trigger: a prompt such as "Name: " is shown with stripping enabled, which happens when the stream is not a TTY (piped output or CliRunner). Mechanism: strip() removes the trailing space, so input() renders the prompt without the separator. Impact: prompts on non-TTY streams are formatted differently from the echo-based path and from TTY output, with the cursor directly against the colon. Only the ANSI removal was needed, so the strip() call is an unintended change.
